title: Compiler setting
statement: A compiler setting for word size $W$ consists of size and layout data, a light program $P$, and a machine-code list. It includes a local-variable bound $F$, procedure entry positions, a dispatcher position, run limits, and a stack-cell count $Q$; the word size must satisfy the stated fit inequalities for the limits, stack, and dispatcher-sized pool, and the pool bound must satisfy $2(F+1)\leq\mathrm{disp}$. Every procedure body in $P$ must have compiled code at its entry followed by its return sequence, with the resulting code ending no later than the dispatcher, and every body must have width at most $F$; the dispatcher code must occur at the dispatcher position.
hypotheses_covered: A list of procedure entry positions
Word-fit inequalities for the limits, stack, and pool
Every procedure body has its compiled body and return sequence at its entry, ending by the dispatcher
Every procedure body has width at most $F$
The dispatcher code occurs at its designated position
caveat: Several required auxiliary notions, including code placement, body width, and return-sequence size, are used but not defined in the payload.
